changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwtelephonicconsultation AS SELECT tc.id, tc.patient_id, tc.encounter_id, tc.practitioner_id, tc.date_of_call, tc.consultation_content, tc.approval_number, tc.notes, tc.extra_documentation, tc.status, tc.cancellation_reason, tc.cancelled_at, tc.cancelled_by, tc.created_by, tc.created_date, tc.last_modified_by, tc.last_modified_date FROM public.telephonic_consultation tc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwtelephonicconsultation TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwtelephonicconsultation FROM report_user;
